module.name: Scripts
module.purpose: Executable shell script toolkit for running, validating, converting, and batch-processing .fff resonance files. Includes overlay scripts for triadic logic, encryption, and grid operations. Intentionally lightweight and transparent so students can inspect how resonance-time, triadic operators, and TFT constants are processed.

modules_linked: run_tft.sh ↔ formats/example_*.fff — execution engine ↔ .fff input files
validate_tft.sh ↔ formats/specification.md — structural checker ↔ format spec
convert_tft.sh → screen/file output — .fff to human-readable summaries
batch_process.sh → run_tft.sh — bulk orchestration → per-file execution
logic_core.sh ↔ tft/entft/ — triadic logic triggers ↔ encryption layer
encryption.sh ↔ tft/entft/encryptor.py — shell encryption overlay ↔ Python engine
grid_ops.sh ↔ tft/tops/grid_ops.py — shell grid overlay ↔ Python grid engine
session_context.drift: minimal (stable script API — input .fff, output text)
session_context.coherence: stable (POSIX-compatible shell scripts with consistent argument conventions)

structural_grammar.dimensional_envelope: D3–D9 (scripts operate across full dimensional range via .fff input)
structural_grammar.coherence_envelope: C1 (strict input/output contract: .fff in → text out)

overlay_scripts.encryption: encryption.sh — encryption overlay with base-lens awareness
overlay_scripts.grid: grid_ops.sh — grid overlay and validator logic with dimensional alignment

formats (.fff files consumed as input by all core pipeline scripts)

files.purpose: Scripts overview — describes all 7 shell scripts, usage patterns, POSIX prerequisites, and .fff file assumptions.
Web-facing index for the scripts section with descriptions and direct links to each script.
Core execution engine — reads a .fff resonance file and prints computed values (τ_r, D3, D6, D9, T_f, ΛΘ, F3, X).
Structural format checker — validates .fff file structure, checks required fields, enforces format coherence against specification.
Format converter — transforms .fff files into human-readable summaries, translating dimensional data for review and teaching.
Bulk orchestrator — runs multiple .fff files in sequence for batch resonance computation across datasets.
Triadic Logic Trigger — activates core logical operator checks and validator overlays for structural fidelity verification.
Encryption overlay — triggers encryption operations with base-lens awareness, enforcing regime-level data boundaries.
Grid overlay — activates grid operations and validator logic with base-lens fidelity for dimensional alignment checks.
